result:
Each query is written from the doc page alone; none of them was run, so they are untested.

R1: `filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * /name | sort ~(/)`
R2: `filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2`
R3: `filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (* (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2)`
R4: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(/login)) | * count`
R5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number`
R6: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] * (filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) | flat | distinct | sort ~(/) * keyword`
R7: `lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort ~(/)`
R8: `lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0`
R9: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) | * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)`
R10: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(ne "") * lower | distinct | sort ~(/)`
R11: `lines * trim | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * [(split "=" | first | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=" | trim)] | tag ::map`
R12: `/services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | entries * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~(/name)`
R13: `{:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}`
R14: `["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "Elder" "cherry" "fig" "Apple"] * lower | groupBy ~(/) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys | sort ~(/) * keyword`
